product-long-description.value: Our TACTIC model is a high-cut leather boot that is perfectly fit for allround tactical activities. The Tactical boot has a strong shank which makes this boot lightweight and stil provides torsional control when walking around. This boot has an outsole that is oil resistant and it is also resistant to temperatures up to 300°C. With the heel anchor, ladder grip and SRA anti-slip  this boot also provides good grip even when walking over a ceramic tile wetted with a dilute soap solution.
